name: FIBERPRO, Inc.
summary: FIBERPRO, Inc. manufactures fiber optic solutions for telecommunications and fiber optic sensor interrogation. The company offers inertial measurement units; fiber optic gyroscopes; distributed temperature sensing system and receivers; and FBG interrogation system and strain sensor. It also provides photonic solution instruments, such as fiber-loop optical-microwave phase detector, polarization scrambler, lightwave equalizer, multichannel optical power meter, PER meter, broadband ASE source, acoustic fiber cable identifier, audio fiber tracer, optical wafer thickness microgauge, optical thickness measurement system, multichannel birefringence analyzer, programmable PMD emulator solution, and…
